svg.aria-label: Five stacked panels: the LZB system drops and trains stop; the Atocha control centre takes over by radio; the AVE is authorised past a red signal with normal running while the Iryo is stopped ahead; what the rule required, driving on sight at no more than 40 km/h; and the rear-end collision at kilometre 118, five minutes after the Iryo reported it still could not restart
svg.text: computer fault; ~63 km lose LZB; about six trains stop
traffic now managed by voice instructions
both trains shown on the panel
AVE authorised past the red signal; Iryo stopped ahead
"marcha a la vista": drive on sight, never above 40 km/h
block ahead must be clear first
08:48 the Iryo reported it still could not restart
speed under investigation; minister: up to ~200 km/h
